address: Strathearn House, Ferntower Road, Crieff, Perthshire,PH7 3LQ
bio: Treat yourself to a sumptuous Afternoon Tea with a backdrop of lush Perthshire countryside at the historical Crieff Hydro Hotel.  Formerly a Victorian spa, this impressive hotel is now part of a 900-acre resort. Afternoon Tea is served in the bright and sunny Winter Garden Tea Room, with huge windows and balconies overlooking the breathtaking Strathhearn Valley.  Their Afternoon Tea menu comprises a quintessential array of finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones and delicious sweet treats, all washed down with a warming pot of tea. Guests truly wishing to indulge can also enjoy a glass of Prosecco or an 1881 Gin and Tonic!  Crieff Hydro Hotel sits at the heart of Perthshire, just 12 miles from Gleneagles train station and 17 miles from Perth and Dunblane stations. The hotel is also just one hour's drive from both Edinburgh and Glasgow.
